Exact requirement statement: The system shall allow a seller to provide one fashion product image for listing analysis.
Persistence justification: Snapshot image reference; actual file-validation process is transient.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall accept a product title and a product description as text for attribute-claim extraction.
Persistence justification: Original text remains available for review.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall accept the seller-provided product category and make it available to the unsupported-category check.
Persistence justification: Raw category retained even if unsupported.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall predict product type within the five EDA-selected categories using the ResNet/MobileNet main CV model, with CLIP zero-shot maintained as baseline and fallback.
Persistence justification: Primary and CLIP evidence can be compared; weights remain external.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall predict product color from the image, with a dominant-color check used to cross-check the visual color decision.
Persistence justification: Color evidence and optional cross-check.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall perform basic checks of image resolution, blur and brightness and make relevant quality findings available to review and, when the optional Listing Quality Score is enabled, to scoring.
Persistence justification: Summaries persisted; raw pixel transforms transient.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall normalize title and description text and extract only product-type and color claims using a controlled vocabulary, rules and fuzzy matching.
Persistence justification: Structured claims; NLP normalization computations transient.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall identify Arabic characters to select the small fixed Arabic lexicon and otherwise apply the English vocabulary.
Persistence justification: Records lexicon routing for extracted claims; per-token detection transient.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall compare image-supported product type and color with claims extracted from title and description using rules and a lightweight mismatch classifier.
Persistence justification: Stores material differences; comparisons computed by application.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall flag contradictions between visual product type and text claims and distinguish same-group from different-group contradictions.
Persistence justification: Type contradiction evidence.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall apply color-family and near-shade rules to flag different-family color contradictions while allowing minor or ignored near-shade differences.
Persistence justification: Color family contradiction evidence.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall identify when an image-supported product type or color is absent from the submitted text rather than contradicted by it.
Persistence justification: Optional finding if supporting feature retained.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall expose confidence for visual predictions and mismatch findings, distinguishing confidence from verified correctness.
Persistence justification: Stores available calibrated confidence, not truth guarantee.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall flag predictions below the configured validation-derived confidence threshold and route affected listings to Needs Review rather than asserting certainty.
Persistence justification: Threshold configured externally; decisions persisted.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall flag suspected out-of-scope images when CV and CLIP disagree, the predicted type contradicts the seller category, or CLIP favors the other-product prompt, avoiding a forced definitive type.
Persistence justification: Supported category remains controlled and unknown until EDA.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall associate applicable findings with the proposal-defined reason codes and a plain-language explanation template.
Persistence justification: Six allowed codes and nonblank explanation.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall assign severity using the approved product-group and color-family rule table.
Persistence justification: Rule application is transient; resulting severity persisted.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall calculate a transparent 0–100 Listing Quality Score from image quality, attribute completeness and image-text consistency only.
Persistence justification: Optional 0–100 output; SQL allows NULL if deferred.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall calculate a heuristic Listing Inconsistency Level from the number and severity of Major and Critical mismatches.
Persistence justification: Low/Medium/High result recorded; rule computation external.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall assign each analyzed listing to the proposal-defined review status based on inconsistency, low confidence, image blur, missing attributes and unsupported-category flags.
Persistence justification: Queue derived from latest run; no redundant queue table.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall propose a corrected title and description through controlled templates grounded only in supported type and color predictions, without using an LLM.
Persistence justification: Template output stored; template files remain external.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall present original and proposed listing text side by side and indicate what changed and why.
Persistence justification: UI comparison generated from saved snapshots.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall allow the seller to accept a presented correction explicitly without automatically publishing the listing.
Persistence justification: Explicit acceptance with no publish capability.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall allow the seller to modify the proposed text before approving their chosen wording, without autonomous publication.
Persistence justification: Stores seller-approved edited wording without changing original.

Exact requirement statement: The system shall allow the seller to ignore a suggested correction and retain the original listing text for that decision.
Persistence justification: Unapplied suggestion; original input retained.
